reason: I travel a lot and always leave pills at home, so a sachet I can toss in my bag with the 2 capsules already counted actually fits how I live. The $24.99 launch price and the money-back guarantee make it a small risk to try once.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a chore, and I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles I stopped taking. Made in China makes me want to see that lab report before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for my batch did not open or the batch number did not match, I would not buy.
